description: agentwatch coach: health check after each tool call, asks you before a catastrophic command (rm -rf ~, git push --force, mkfs, curl | sh, ...) or a read of a secrets file (.env, SSH keys, cloud credentials) (PreToolUse), and a one-time block of a call that repeats a HIGH loop (PreToolUse; AGENTWATCH_LOOP_BREAKER=off disables it). `; exit 0` keeps the hook a silent no-op (no hook-error notice) when agentwatch is not on PATH; it works in both Git Bash and PowerShell.
